# Bank Payment Setup

Builds an illustrative ACME bank Payment Instruction through shared Payment Setup. It sets details to method `acme-bank` and confirmation `bank`, installs the bank method clause and otherwise passes empty configuration, terms and instruction overrides.

The inherited builder validates the active context, amount/currency, participant channels and destination identity, and lowers request connections into the instruction. Bank requests are not evidence of bank execution. Authorization, capture and refund outcomes require their separate recorded confirmations.
